# PDF font test fixture

`arimo-regular.ttf` is the Arimo regular face from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@expo-google-fonts/arimo/Arimo_400Regular.ttf.
Its SIL Open Font License is included as `ARIMO-OFL.txt` from
https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/arimo/OFL.txt.

This font is used only for offline integration tests. It is not bundled with
the application or used as a production fallback.
